title: Reappraisal of the dynamic Airy chaotic substitution box and affine class selection of power map representatives: code and data
description: Code, result files, CSV tables (lookup tables, DDT, LAT, BCT) and mapped gate-level netlists that regenerate every number of the manuscript: metric engine, affine-class selection and its executable specification, exact count of ideal-SAC representatives, generator ablation, affine-class statistics, annealing parameter study, 32-bit example SPN with MILP and exact trail analysis, test vectors, common-condition logic synthesis on two open cell libraries, Verilog descriptions, tests, a tiered verification report and the manuscript verification script.
